correctness.rationale: The published Grundbacher–Kobos formula f(p)=||(d_i)||_{2p/|p-2|} is substituted with p_r=2r/(r-2), yielding exactly S(r)=f(p_r)^r=sum_i d_i^r for all r>2. A finite ordered exponential sum has D1=lim S(r)^(1/r), m1=lim S(r)/D1^r, and subtracting m1 D1^r inductively identifies all remaining distances and multiplicities. For p=2±h, r=4/h±2, so the lower levels are O(e^{-c/h}); division by r gives cusp derivatives ±D log m/4 when maximum multiplicity m>=2 and C-infinity flatness at p2 for m=1. Source checker was read; finite sampling is illustrative, not the proof. The exact-data hypothesis is indispensable.
